name: comment-thread
title: CommentThread
description: Controlled comment thread + composer. Renders an ordered list of comments (Avatar + author + Timestamp + body) followed by a composer (Textarea + submit Button). The list is controlled via comments; only the composer draft is local state. A non-empty trimmed body calls onSubmit(body) and clears the draft; empty/whitespace never submits. No comments -> honest empty state, composer still shows. Composes Avatar/Textarea/Button/Timestamp — zero new dependency.
